info.title: Autobahn CLI
info.description: Command-line front end for Autobahn: run a load test, watch it live in the terminal, and write its reports.

options.name: --target
options.description: Run only this scenario. Repeatable.

options.name: --config
options.description: Load a JSON config file or URL.

options.name: --infra
options.description: Load an infrastructure config file or URL.

options.name: --out
options.description: Where the reports go.

options.name: --name
options.description:
What the report files are called.
Where the generated file goes.

options.name: --format
options.description: Report formats, comma-separated: Txt, Html, Csv, Md, Json.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None.

options.name: --suite
options.description: Test suite name.

options.name: --test-name
options.description:
Test name.
What the generated scenario is called.
Environment variables layer between the JSON config and the command line, under
the AUTOBAHN_ prefix: AUTOBAHN_REPORT_FOLDER, AUTOBAHN_TARGET_SCENARIOS,
AUTOBAHN_REPORT_FORMATS, AUTOBAHN_REPORTING_INTERVAL and a few more.
Exit codes:
0  the run finished and every threshold passed
1  the command line, the file or the run itself was wrong
2  the run finished and a threshold failed
The web view is for watching a run while it happens. A finished run is read from
the reports it wrote - the html one for a person, the json one for a machine.

options.name: --reporting-interval
options.description: How often live statistics are produced, e.g. 00:00:10.

options.name: --show-config
options.description: Print every effective setting and where it came from.

options.name: --no-runtime-metrics
options.description: Do not collect the load generator's own CPU, GC and so on.

options.name: --no-reports
options.description: Write no report files. The console summary still prints.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version.
Options for 'run', for the live web view:

options.name: --ui
options.description: Serve it. On by default at a terminal, off without one.

options.name: --no-ui
options.description: Do not serve it.

options.name: --ui-port
options.description: The port. 0, the default, picks a free one.

options.name: --ui-public
options.description:
Serve on every interface rather than loopback. Loud on
purpose: this surface can stop the run.

options.name: --ui-open
options.description:
Open the printed URL in a browser.
Options for 'record':

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Emit a class in this namespace instead of a .csx script.

options.name: --headless
options.description: Record without a browser window; captures the page load only.

options.name: --include-assets
options.description: Keep images, stylesheets, fonts and scripts.

options.name: --all-origins
options.description:
Record third-party requests too, not just the site's own.
--keep-browser-headers Keep the browser's user-agent and sec-* headers.

options.name: --browser-path
options.description:
Use a Chromium this machine already has, rather than
the build the Playwright package pins. Also
AUTOBAHN_BROWSER_PATH.
